articles.title: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy

articles.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
articles.summary: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said Monday that policymakers have more work to do to bring inflation under control, though he indicated that further action can unfold over time as the economy continues to grow. He also said that while artificial intelligence is pressuring prices, there's "little evidence" it will be the source of more persistent inflation.
